userStories.title: Create Acceptance Policy Service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need logic to evaluate if a bet should be auto-accepted or queued.
acceptanceCriteria: Create AcceptancePolicyService.swift in Booki/Services/
Add enum PolicyViolation with cases: stakeTooHigh, stakeRequiresReview, newPlayer, parlayNotAllowed, parlayTooManyLegs, eventLocked
Add static function evaluateBet(stake:isParlay:parlayLegs:playerBetCount:event:policy:) -> [PolicyViolation]
Stake check: stake > policy.autoAcceptMaxStake returns .stakeTooHigh
Stake check: stake > policy.requireReviewAboveStake returns .stakeRequiresReview
New player check: playerBetCount < policy.newPlayerBetThreshold AND !policy.autoAcceptNewPlayers returns .newPlayer
Parlay check: isParlay AND !policy.autoAcceptParlays returns .parlayNotAllowed
Parlay legs check: isParlay AND parlayLegs > policy.parlayMaxLegs returns .parlayTooManyLegs
Event lock check: event.startTime <= Date() + policy.eventLockOffsetMinutes returns .eventLocked
Add function violationDescription(_:) -> String that returns human-readable text for each violation
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Pure logic service - no side effects, easy to test

userStories.title: Integrate Policy Evaluation into Bet Submission

acceptanceCriteria: Modify BetService.submitBet to accept optional policy: AcceptancePolicy? parameter
Modify BetService.submitBet to accept isParlay: Bool and parlayLegs: Int parameters
Modify BetService.submitBet to accept playerBetCount: Int parameter
When policy provided, call AcceptancePolicyService.evaluateBet
If no violations (empty array): set bet status to .accepted
If violations present: set bet status to .pending and store violation reasons in policyViolationReason
If .eventLocked violation: return failure with appropriate error instead of creating bet
If no policy provided: default to .pending (backwards compatible)
Update BetSlipSheet.submitBets to query AcceptancePolicy and pass to BetService
Update BetSlipSheet.submitBets to pass isParlay, parlayLegs, playerBetCount
